policy: Evidence-backed editorial scope exclusions or holds take precedence over automatic model adoption. These are scope decisions, not scientific-quality judgments. Match exact DOI or source identifier, never title alone. No rule can bypass metadata or quality checks.

records.title: Fait Accompli Committee Selection: Improving the Size-Security Tradeoff of Stake-Based Committees
records.reason: Primary contribution is low-variance committee sampling and probabilistic size-security bounds under an assumed corrupted stake fraction. The Cardano incentive discussion contextualizes observed stake distributions; it does not establish a substantive strategic/economic model, equilibrium or incentive-design result of this paper. Outside the current intersection; not a quality rejection.
locators: Publisher PDF abstract and problem definition, pp.845-846

No automatic adoption or quality rejection; do not expand scope to all rational distributed algorithms based on venue or model label.

records.reason: Primary manuscript derives double-spend success probabilities, incomplete-beta formulas, asymptotics and confirmation-time risk conditional on fixed attacker hashpower. This is mathematically substantive, but a payoff, incentive, equilibrium or economic-choice contribution has not been established. Current intersection requires that further evidence; do not admit solely because the venue is Finance or the attack involves money. No quality rejection or unrequested foundational exception.
